description: This file sets up and runs an AI-powered conversational bot using Pipecat framework components, including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, language model, and transport handlers, with event-driven architecture.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the context for the language model, holding message history.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Handles aggregation of user and assistant responses within the LLM context.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversational pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline instance with parameters and execution control.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, including starting, stopping, and handling signals.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the AI bot with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot process.
